description: Reusable skill challenge templates for contextual gameplay with balance tuning
note: Updated for the nine-skill primary/secondary attribute system. Every authored approach may select one of its skill's two permitted attributes.

trap_detect_disarm.name: Trap Detection & Disarm
trap_detect_disarm.description: The floor ahead is worn smooth except for one suspicious seam. A careless step could answer the question for you. Read the mechanism before putting your weight on it.

presentation.alt: An uneven stone floor beneath a worn recessed wall panel.

stages.description: Notice the trap before triggering it

onSuccess.message: You spot the trap mechanism!

onFailure.message: You trigger the trap!

stages.description: Carefully disable the trap mechanism

onSuccess.message: You successfully disarm the trap!

onFailure.message: Your hand slips...

criticalSuccess.message: Masterful work! You find a hidden compartment with treasure

criticalFailure.message: The trap was more deadly than you thought...

locked_door.name: Locked Door
locked_door.description: The door holds fast. Its lock, ironwork and possible ward each suggest a different way through. Choose your approach carefully: an attempted failure leaves this passage closed for this run.

presentation.alt: A closed iron-bound timber door in a shadowed stone passage.

options.description: Listen for the lock's small movements and ease it open without forcing the mechanism.

onSuccess.message: The final catch lifts. You ease the door open, listening to the quiet on the other side.

onFailure.message: The mechanism catches. You withdraw before damaging your tools; the lock remains shut.

options.description: Set your shoulder against the ironwork and force the door before your footing gives.

onSuccess.message: The frame gives with a sharp report. You steady yourself as the door swings clear.

onFailure.message: You hurt your shoulder trying to break down the door.

options.description: Read the ward around the lock and try to unravel the working that holds it.

onSuccess.message: You follow the seal's pattern to its weak point. The working loosens; the lock finally yields.

onFailure.message: The magical seal resists your attempts.

presentation.alt: A simple barrier across a quiet frontier road.

bandit_negotiation.name: Bandit Negotiation
bandit_negotiation.description: The bandits spread across your path and wait for your answer. You have a little room to speak before this becomes a fight. Conviction, a convincing lie, or an appeal to the people behind the weapons might carry the moment.

options.description: Threaten or persuade the bandits to leave

onSuccess.message: The bandits are convinced by your words and flee!

onFailure.message: The bandits reject your words and attack!

options.description: Trick the bandits with false information

onSuccess.message: The bandits believe your lie about approaching guards and flee!

onFailure.message: The bandits see through your deception and attack!

options.description: Reassure the bandits and appeal to their better nature

onSuccess.message: You connect with the bandits emotionally. They agree to leave peacefully!

onFailure.message: Your emotional appeal falls flat and they attack!

cliff_climb.name: Cliff Climbing
cliff_climb.description: The cliff offers plenty of cracks and very few trustworthy holds. First find a line you can follow; then commit your weight to it. What looks sound from below may crumble under your fingers.

presentation.alt: Weathered handholds and an exposed ledge on a steep rock face.

stages.description: Trace a line of holds before committing; a sound reading will make the climb easier.

onSuccess.message: You identify handholds and a safe path.

onFailure.message: You begin climbing without a clear plan.

stages.description: Test each hold before trusting it, keeping enough strength for the pull over the lip.

onSuccess.message: You pull yourself over the lip. The valley falls away below you.

onFailure.message: Your boot finds nothing. Three seconds of silence, then stone.

hidden_treasure.name: Hidden Treasure Search
hidden_treasure.description: Something about this place rewards a second look: a fitted edge, a trace of wear where the surroundings are untouched. If there is a concealed compartment, finding it and opening it are two different problems.

presentation.alt: A closed wooden compartment has a subtle worn catch.

variants.alt: A recessed stone panel and shadowed chamber passage.

stages.description: Compare edges and wear across the area; look for a surface that has been handled rather than weathered.

onSuccess.message: You find signs of a hidden compartment!

onFailure.message: You find nothing of interest.

stages.description: Work the concealed catch gently. Finding the compartment has not made its mechanism any less stubborn.

onSuccess.message: Your fingers find the latch. Inside: worth the trouble.

onFailure.message: The mechanism is seized. Whatever's inside stays inside.

presentation.alt: An alert grey wolf hesitates on ordinary earthy ground.

calm_wild_beast.name: Calm Wild Beast
calm_wild_beast.description: The animal bars your way, snarling at every movement. Closing the distance would be a mistake. Keep still, read its fear, and see whether you can give it a reason to withdraw.

onSuccess.message: The animal reads you. Something in your stillness tells it you're not prey. It moves off.

onFailure.message: The animal remains hostile and attacks!

presentation.alt: A watch lantern casts warm light beside a dark opening.

sneak_past_guards.name: Sneak Past Guards
sneak_past_guards.description: The guards' patrol leaves brief gaps, but each one closes quickly. You could move quietly, wait for their attention to turn, or walk through as though you belong. Being challenged will mean a fight.

options.description: Move silently past the guards

onSuccess.message: You slip past the guards unnoticed.

onFailure.message: Your heel finds a loose stone. A guard turns.

options.description: Hide in the shadows and wait for an opening

onSuccess.message: You blend into the shadows and slip past when they're not looking.

onFailure.message: A guard spots you hiding!

options.description: Bluff your way past with confidence

onSuccess.message: You walk past confidently and the guards don't question you.

onFailure.message: The guards challenge you and attack!

arcane_puzzle.name: Arcane Puzzle
arcane_puzzle.description: Faint runes gather around the door's mechanism. Repeated marks suggest a pattern, though not its meaning. You could interpret the working, investigate its sequence, or treat it as something built to be rearranged.

presentation.alt: An ancient fitted stone panel bearing worn abstract incisions.

options.description: Read the runes as a working: look for the principle that makes the sequence hold together.

onSuccess.message: The apparent contradictions resolve into a single working. You complete its pattern and the mechanism responds.

onFailure.message: The puzzle remains unsolved.

options.description: Compare repeated marks and worn edges until a consistent sequence emerges.

onSuccess.message: One worn edge repeats where the others do not. You follow the pattern through; the mechanism answers with a quiet click.

onFailure.message: The puzzle is too complex to understand.

options.description: Treat the sequence as a made thing: test how its parts fit rather than what its symbols mean.

onSuccess.message: You stop trying to read the sequence and start fitting it together. The last adjustment settles into place.

onFailure.message: Your unconventional approach doesn't work.

presentation.alt: A weathered stone tablet with eroded abstract marks.

ancient_text.name: Decipher Ancient Text
ancient_text.description: Writing crowds the stone tablet, interrupted by damage and long use. Enough remains to tempt a reading. Work from what you can actually decipher; an attractive guess is still a guess.

onSuccess.message: You translate the ancient text and gain valuable information!

onFailure.message: The text is too damaged or complex to understand.

presentation.alt: Linen bandages and a water bowl prepared for first aid.

stabilize_wounded.name: Stabilize Wounded NPC
stabilize_wounded.description: The wounded person's breathing is shallow and the bleeding has not stopped. Medical knowledge may tell you what to do; careful examination may show you where to begin. There is little room for an uncertain hand.

options.description: Apply scholarly medical knowledge

onSuccess.message: You stabilize the wounded person using your medical knowledge!

onFailure.message: Despite your efforts, the person's condition worsens.

options.description: Examine the wounds and apply practical first aid

onSuccess.message: You identify the injury and treat it effectively!

onFailure.message: You cannot determine how to help them.

presentation.alt: Disturbed earth and pressed grass suggest recent passage.

track_creature.name: Track Creature
track_creature.description: A few disturbed patches break the ground's ordinary pattern. They might resolve into a trail if you can separate fresh passage from old marks. Finding the signs is only the first part; keeping them is the next.

stages.description: Examine the tracks more closely

onSuccess.message: You identify fresh tracks leading away from here. The creature passed through recently.

onFailure.message: The tracks are too faint or confused to follow.

stages.description: Piece together the trail from fleeting signs

onSuccess.message: The signs are everywhere once you know them: a pressed reed, a turned stone, a blood-fleck on bark. You have it.

onFailure.message: You lose the trail in the undergrowth.

presentation.alt: Two plain clay cups sit apart across a worn table.

detect_lie.name: Detect Deception
detect_lie.description: The account almost holds together. A pause falls in the wrong place; one detail seems too carefully supplied. Listen for what changes when they think you have accepted it.

onSuccess.message: You sense the NPC is being deceptive!

onFailure.message: You believe the NPC is telling the truth.

presentation.alt: A simple clay cup lies on its side in a pool of light.

creative_distraction.name: Create Distraction
creative_distraction.description: Their attention is exactly where you do not want it. A small, well-timed disturbance might be enough. Make it convincing without making yourself the most interesting thing here.

onSuccess.message: Your clever distraction works perfectly, creating an opening!

onFailure.message: Your distraction attempt fails to fool anyone.

votive_record.name: Read the Votive Record
votive_record.description: Someone kept count here, returning often enough to wear the surface around the marks. The record is still legible. Look for repetition, omissions, and the point at which the pattern changes.

presentation.alt: Timeworn markings on a fitted stone surface.

onSuccess.message: You work out who left what, and when. The last mark is recent.

onFailure.message: The marks don't resolve into anything you can read.

narrow_ledge.name: Narrow Ledge
narrow_ledge.description: The ledge narrows around the rock, leaving little room to recover a misplaced foot. Study its surface before committing. Beyond the first step, balance matters more than haste.

presentation.alt: A narrow continuous stone shelf curves through a cave.

variants.alt: An exposed natural ledge follows a continuous rock face.

stages.description: Study the ledge patiently before committing

onSuccess.message: The ledge is narrow — six inches, maybe eight. You note where to step.

onFailure.message: You approach without a plan.

stages.description: Cross the narrow ledge

onSuccess.message: You make it across. Don't look down was good advice.

onFailure.message: The ledge crumbles under your foot. Stone and then air.

presentation.alt: A worn travel pack and repaired cloak suggest a hard journey.

variants.alt: Soft muddy banks and shallow marsh water.
An exposed gravel desert under pale daylight.
A cold snowy route through ordinary woodland.
Dense green vegetation crossing a narrow route.

endure_harsh_environment.name: Endure Harsh Environment
endure_harsh_environment.description: The conditions are beginning to dictate your pace. Read the warning signs while you still have strength to act on them; then settle into an effort you can sustain.

stages.description: Read the terrain for what's coming

onSuccess.message: The ground tells a story: scorched rock, dead insects, cracked mud. You know what this means.

onFailure.message: The conditions build without warning.

stages.description: Endure the harsh conditions

onSuccess.message: You push through the harsh conditions!

onFailure.message: The conditions overwhelm you.

presentation.alt: A heavy rounded boulder blocks a shallow rocky passage.

boulder_push.name: Move Heavy Boulder
boulder_push.description: The boulder fills the passage, but the ground around its base shows where it might shift. Find purchase, set your footing, and decide whether your strength will move the stone before it gives out.

onSuccess.message: The boulder grinds aside. Behind it: packed earth, and beneath that, something worth hiding.

onFailure.message: You strain your muscles but the boulder won't budge.

mountain_climb.name: Mountain Climbing
mountain_climb.description: The slope steepens until every promising line hides another difficult stretch. Read the rock before choosing your ascent. A route you can see is not always a route you can hold.

presentation.alt: Steep weathered mountain rock with small holds and exposed ledges.

stages.description: Find the safest climbing route

onSuccess.message: You identify a manageable path up the mountain!

onFailure.message: You proceed without a clear route.

stages.description: Scale the steep slope

onSuccess.message: You successfully climb the mountain!

onFailure.message: You slip and fall!

heat_endurance.name: Desert Heat Wave
heat_endurance.description: The sun presses down until even small movements feel expensive. Read the ground for a less punishing line, then keep a steady pace. Heat makes poor decisions feel reasonable.

presentation.alt: Bleached stony ground and distant ridges under harsh sunlight.

stages.description: Notice the heat before it becomes something else

onSuccess.message: The air above the sand shimmers. You slow down, drink, cover exposed skin. Not yet, but coming.

onFailure.message: The heat builds without warning.

stages.description: Endure the scorching heat

onSuccess.message: You endure the extreme heat and press onward!

onFailure.message: The heat overwhelms you.

swamp_navigation.name: Navigate Treacherous Swamp
swamp_navigation.description: Dark water hides the ground between the reeds. A firm-looking patch may be only roots over mud. You can read the marsh, test a quick-footed crossing, or study the small signs that distinguish a route from a trap.

presentation.alt: Shallow marsh pools between soft muddy banks and patches of grass.

options.description: Probe the ground before trusting it, reading how roots and water give under pressure.

onSuccess.message: Each test rules out another false foothold. You follow the ground that holds and leave the deeper mud behind.

onFailure.message: You step into quicksand!

options.description: Move lightly between the firmer patches before the mud can take your weight.

onSuccess.message: You keep your weight moving from one firm patch to the next. Behind you, the water settles into the spaces you avoided.

onFailure.message: You lose your footing and sink!

options.description: Read the reeds, roots and standing water for the marsh's more dependable ground.

onSuccess.message: The vegetation gives away what the water hides. You follow its changes onto firmer ground.

onFailure.message: The swamp is more treacherous than expected.

presentation.alt: Dense green stems and bracken obstruct a route.

variants.alt: Snow-covered branches obstruct a winter woodland route.

dense_undergrowth.name: Dense Jungle Undergrowth
dense_undergrowth.description: The growth closes across your route, woven tightly enough to catch a pack or turn a foot. Find the places that yield before forcing your way through. Every careless movement catches on something.

onSuccess.message: You find a path through the dense vegetation!

onFailure.message: Thorny vines tear at your skin.

cliff_climb_advanced.name: Scale Mountain Peak
cliff_climb_advanced.description: The rock rises almost vertically, its holds scattered far enough apart to demand commitment. Study the line carefully. On this face, strength spent correcting a mistake may be strength you need higher up.

presentation.alt: An exposed steep rock face with scattered weathered handholds.

stages.description: Study the treacherous peak route

onSuccess.message: You map out a challenging but possible route!

onFailure.message: The route looks insurmountable.

stages.description: Sustain the long climb to the peak

onSuccess.message: You reach the summit!

onFailure.message: You lose your grip and plummet!

presentation.alt: A coherent ice wall covers a shaded rock face.

ice_climbing.name: Ice Wall Climbing
ice_climbing.description: The ice offers pale ridges that might hold and smooth stretches that certainly will not. Read its surface before beginning the climb. Each move needs a secure answer to the one before it.

stages.description: Read the ice before you commit your weight

onSuccess.message: The blue-grey patches hold. The white streaks don't. You file that away.

onFailure.message: You begin climbing without reading the ice.

stages.description: Climb the ice wall

onSuccess.message: Handhold by handhold. You reach the top and press your face against the cold.

onFailure.message: Your grip breaks. The wall rushes past you.

river_crossing.name: Cross Swift River
river_crossing.description: The river looks shallower where it runs fastest. Rocks break the surface, but the water between them pulls hard. Strength, balance, or a careful reading of the current could get you across.

presentation.alt: A swift river flowing around a few low rounded boulders.

options.description: Brace against the current and wade across, keeping your weight low.

onSuccess.message: The current shoves at every step. You keep your footing until your boots finally find the far bank.

onFailure.message: The bed drops beneath your next step. The current rolls you against stone before you drag yourself clear.

options.description: Trust your balance on the exposed stones, committing before the next wave washes over them.

onSuccess.message: One wet stone, then another. Your last step lands on firm ground with the river still reaching behind you.

onFailure.message: A stone turns slick beneath your boot. You strike hard on the way into the water and scramble back out.

options.description: Study the current and riverbed for a ford instead of fighting the deepest water.

onSuccess.message: The broken surface gives the riverbed away. You follow the shallower line and reach the far bank.

onFailure.message: What looked like shallows gives way beneath you. The current batters you before you regain the bank.

presentation.alt: A plain watch lantern hangs from an unmarked timber.

guard_patrol.name: Guard Patrol
guard_patrol.description: The guards approach with the manner of people expecting an explanation. Decide how to account for yourself before they decide what your hesitation means.

onSuccess.message: The guards nod and wave you through.

onFailure.message: The guards remain suspicious and demand you leave the area.

onSuccess.message: The guards pocket the coin and look the other way.

onFailure.message: The guards are offended and threaten arrest!

choices.text: Blend into the crowd and slip away

onSuccess.message: You disappear into the crowd before they notice.

onFailure.message: The guards spot you and give chase!

presentation.alt: Plain cloth, pottery and repaired leather await appraisal.

market_haggle.name: Market Haggling
market_haggle.description: The asking price leaves room for negotiation, if you can give the merchant a reason to move. Listen to the offer before answering it; confidence alone does not make a bargain.

onSuccess.message: The merchant grudgingly accepts your counteroffer!

onFailure.message: The merchant refuses to budge on price.

presentation.alt: A closed cloth purse rests beside ordinary merchant wares.

pickpocket_attempt.name: Pickpocket Encounter
pickpocket_attempt.description: A hand drifts toward the merchant's belongings while their attention is elsewhere. You have noticed it early enough to act. Choose your intervention before the moment passes.

choices.text: Catch the thief and demand they return the goods

onSuccess.message: You catch the thief! The merchant rewards you.

onFailure.message: The thief escapes into the crowd.

onSuccess.message: Guards arrive quickly and apprehend the thief.

onFailure.message: By the time guards arrive, the thief is long gone.

onSuccess.message: You mind your own business.

presentation.alt: A warehouse doorway opens onto a dim storage aisle.

warehouse_sneak.name: Warehouse Infiltration
warehouse_sneak.description: Activity inside the warehouse does not fit the quiet outside it. There may be a way to learn more without announcing yourself. First read the openings, then choose when to move.

stages.description: Hide in the shadows and observe

onSuccess.message: You spot smugglers loading contraband!

onFailure.message: A guard spots movement and investigates!

stages.description: Search for evidence of criminal activity

onSuccess.message: You find smuggling manifests! The city guard will reward this.

onFailure.message: You find nothing conclusive.

presentation.alt: A narrow earthen edge runs beside young planted crops.

crop_trampling.name: Crop Field Crossing
crop_trampling.description: Your route crosses worked ground, and the farmer is watching. Their suspicion is understandable: a careless crossing can undo careful work. Choose how to make your passage acceptable.

onSuccess.message: The farmer grants permission and shows you the safest path.

onFailure.message: The farmer refuses and warns you away.

choices.text: Navigate carefully to avoid trampling crops

onSuccess.message: You cross without damaging the crops.

onFailure.message: You accidentally trample several rows! The farmer demands compensation.

choices.text: Walk straight through, crops be damned

onSuccess.message: You cross quickly but anger the farmer.

presentation.alt: Fire has spread onto kindling beside a small stone forge.

forge_accident.name: Forge Fire
forge_accident.description: The forge fire is spreading beyond its proper bounds. Rushing in without reading the danger could make you another person needing help. Assess what is feeding it before attempting to bring it under control.

stages.description: Brave the heat to get close to the fire

onSuccess.message: You withstand the intense heat!

onFailure.message: The heat is too intense!

stages.description: Pour water and beat back the flames

onSuccess.message: You successfully extinguish the blaze! The workers are grateful.

onFailure.message: The fire spreads! Workers rush to help.

presentation.alt: Pressed grass and disturbed earth hint at unseen passage.

predator_stalk.name: Predator Stalking
predator_stalk.description: The quiet behind you keeps arriving a moment late. Something is matching your progress. Find the signs before turning uncertainty into an encounter you cannot control.

stages.description: Notice the predator before it commits

onSuccess.message: A shadow at the edge of the tall grass. Eyes. You stop moving.

onFailure.message: You sense something wrong. Too late to do anything about it.

stages.description: Face down the predator

onSuccess.message: The predator backs down. You hold your ground until it turns.

onFailure.message: It charges. You had no good options anyway.

desert_wayfinding.name: Desert Wayfinding
desert_wayfinding.description: The desert repeats itself in every direction. A ridge that looked distinctive now resembles three others. Establish your bearings from the ground and sky before committing to another line.

presentation.alt: A dry, wind-scoured expanse of pale earth and repeated distant ridges.

stages.description: Read the sun and landscape for orientation

onSuccess.message: The sun is a clock. You triangulate against two ridgelines and a dune shadow. Heading set.

onFailure.message: The glare is blinding. You pick a direction and hope.

stages.description: Hold your bearing through the heat

onSuccess.message: The heat tries everything. You're still pointed the right way when the dunes break open.

onFailure.message: The sun shifts. So do your footprints. You've been walking in a slow arc for the last hour.

beach_salvage.name: Shipwreck Salvage
beach_salvage.description: Wreck debris shifts in the shallows, briefly visible between the waves. First decide what is worth reaching for. Then time your attempt before the water closes over it again.

presentation.alt: A tidal shoreline strewn with seaweed, wet stones and weathered driftwood.

stages.description: Spot salvageable cargo before the tide takes it

onSuccess.message: A sealed crate. Still floating. You mark its drift and move.

onFailure.message: Splinters and sailcloth. You wade in anyway.

stages.description: Drag the cargo clear of the surf

onSuccess.message: Cold to the bone. Worth it.

onFailure.message: The surf takes it. You watch it go under.

presentation.alt: Two mismatched clay cups leave space for a conversation.

gather_rumors.name: Gather Rumors
gather_rumors.description: The innkeeper hears more than most people mean to tell. Give the conversation room to wander, then listen for the detail they stop treating as idle gossip.

choices.text: Buy them a drink and ask casually — Empathy DC 11 (costs 5 gold)

onSuccess.message: Over a shared drink, the innkeeper lets slip something useful.

onFailure.message: They smile politely and change the subject.

choices.text: Ask directly — you heard there's trouble — Investigation DC 14

onSuccess.message: Your direct approach catches them off guard. They confirm what you suspected.

onFailure.message: They clam up. Too forward.

choices.text: Maintain a cover as a traveling merchant — Influence (Composure) DC 13

onSuccess.message: Your false identity opens doors. The innkeeper warns you about the roads.

onFailure.message: They see through the act. Their expression cools.

presentation.alt: Worn merchant wares show their material and repairs.

appraise_goods.name: Appraise Goods
appraise_goods.description: The wares look convincing at a glance. Look again at wear, joins and repairs before deciding what the price actually buys. Good presentation can conceal ordinary work.

onSuccess.message: You assess the stock with a practiced eye. You know exactly what's worth buying.

onFailure.message: The quality is hard to judge. You're not sure what's genuine.

presentation.alt: A plain iron fitting lies on a scarred smith's bench.

identify_item_quality.name: Read the Craft
identify_item_quality.description: A maker's skill survives in the details: an even finish, a well-fitted join, a repair that respects the old work. Examine what the blacksmith has made before judging the hands that made it.

onSuccess.message: You spot the hallmarks of exceptional craft. This smith knows their trade.

onFailure.message: The metalwork is competent but you can't read more than that.

presentation.alt: Simple tongs and a hammer lie beside unfinished ironwork.

craft_assistance.name: Lend a Hand
craft_assistance.description: The blacksmith has reached the part of the job that leaves no spare hand. Before offering yours, understand what they are trying to hold, shape or fit. Useful help begins with noticing.

choices.text: Grip the metal and work the bellows — Craft (Prowess) DC 14

onSuccess.message: You haul and hold. The smith nods, impressed. The job goes faster.

onFailure.message: You fumble the grip. The smith waves you off, jaw tight.

choices.text: Suggest a technique from something you've studied — Craft (Intellect) DC 13

onSuccess.message: The smith raises an eyebrow, tries it, and it works. Respect earned.

onFailure.message: The suggestion falls flat. Book learning doesn't translate here.

presentation.alt: Two clay cups sit apart in a quiet pool of lamplight.

intimidate_npc.name: Intimidating Presence
intimidate_npc.description: There is a point at which a request becomes a threat. You can cross it, but they will remember the manner of your approach. Make the pressure convincing if you choose to use it.

onSuccess.message: They measure you and decide cooperation costs less than resistance.

onFailure.message: They hold your gaze. Your threat lands hollow.

presentation.alt: Space between two cups suggests an unresolved discussion.

negotiate.name: Negotiate Terms
negotiate.description: They have a reason to refuse, and perhaps a better reason to agree. Find the part of your proposal that serves them as well as you. A workable bargain needs both sides to see it.

onSuccess.message: They see the angle and nod slowly. Terms accepted.

onFailure.message: The deal doesn't look appealing enough to them.

presentation.alt: A quiet table holds two ordinary drinking cups.

persuade_npc.name: Make Your Case
persuade_npc.description: Repeating the request will not change the answer. Find an angle they have not considered, and make its value clear in terms they can accept.

onSuccess.message: Your argument is clear and well-reasoned. They yield the point.

onFailure.message: They're not convinced. Perhaps another approach.

presentation.alt: A hooded watch lantern lights an unmarked timber post.

gather_information.name: Ask the Guard
gather_information.description: The guards see who comes and goes, but that does not mean they share everything they notice. Choose how to turn routine conversation toward something useful.

choices.text: Ask casually about recent activity — Influence DC 12

onSuccess.message: The guard relaxes and shares what they've seen lately.

onFailure.message: They're not in a talkative mood. 'Move along.'

choices.text: Maintain a false claim of town authority — Influence (Composure) DC 15

onSuccess.message: The authority of the claim loosens their tongue considerably.

onFailure.message: They know the real investigators. This doesn't add up.

choices.text: Don't ask — read their posture and fill in the gaps — Empathy DC 14

onSuccess.message: You don't need them to talk. Their body language tells the story.

onFailure.message: Nothing readable in their expression. Professionally blank.
